title: Zapier Integration Tools
summary: This module provides a factory function to generate a list of Zapier action tools, allowing agents to interact with Zapier's extensive automation capabilities. It supports filtering tools by name and requires a Zapier API key for authentication.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agent
nodes.title: CrewAI Agent
nodes.description: A CrewAI agent that utilizes the generated Zapier tools to perform various automation tasks and interact with external services.

nodes.label: Generate Zapier Tools
nodes.title: Zapier Action Tools Factory
nodes.description: A factory function (ZapierActionTools) that initializes and returns a list of Zapier action tools. It can filter tools based on a provided list of action names and handles API key retrieval.

nodes.label: Adapt Zapier Actions
nodes.title: Zapier Actions Adapter
nodes.description: An internal adapter (ZapierActionsAdapter) responsible for communicating with the Zapier API to fetch available actions and convert them into usable tool objects.

nodes.label: Zapier API
nodes.title: External Zapier Service
nodes.description: The external Zapier platform API, providing a wide range of automation actions that can be integrated as tools.

groups.label: Agent Interaction
groups.title: Agent Interaction with Tools
groups.description: Describes how a CrewAI agent requests and utilizes the Zapier tools to perform tasks.

groups.label: Tool Provisioning
groups.title: Zapier Tool Provisioning
groups.description: Handles the creation, adaptation, and filtering of Zapier action tools for use within the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: External Integration
groups.title: External Zapier Integration
groups.description: Represents the interaction with the external Zapier API to retrieve and execute automation actions.
